name: Pizzeria Mama Mia
kurzbeschreibung:
**Pizzeria Mama Mia in Tannheim**

Welcome to **Pizzeria Mama Mia** in the heart of **Tannheim**, where authentic Italian flavors meet the charm of the **Tirol** Alps. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Pizza Salami**, or a fresh **Caprese**, our handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven.

Pair your meal with a crisp **Aperol Spritz**, a refreshing **Radler**, or one of our house wines from **Tirol**. Don’t miss our delicious **Tiramisu** or **Panna Cotta** for dessert—pure indulgence!

After dinner, take a short stroll through **Tannheim**’s picturesque streets or enjoy the breathtaking views of the surrounding mountains. Whether you're here for a romantic evening, a family gathering, or a quick bite, **Pizzeria Mama Mia** promises an unforgettable dining experience in the heart of **Tirol**.
